title: AI × Chem 每日精选
subtitle: 预印本、方法、数据集与实验验证的每日精选。
method: 公开来源采集、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，依据频道主题与证据信号筛选候选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: MolX: A Geometric Foundation Model for Protein-Ligand Modelling
items.abstract_or_text: Understanding how small molecules interact with protein binding pockets is central to structure-based drug discovery. Accurately modelling these interactions requires capturing the 3D geometry and physicochemical complementarity of binding interfaces, yet existing computational approaches encode proteins and ligands separately or rely on simplified structural representations that do not explicitly model cross-entity spatial relationships. Such decoupled representations restrict their capacity to capture interface-level geometric constraints that arise from protein-ligand coorganisation. Here we present MolX, a Graph Transformer foundation model that jointly learns geometric and chemical representations of protein pockets and ligands from large-scale 3D structural data. Integrating over 3 million protein pockets and 5 million molecules, MolX represents both entities as E(3)-equivariant graphs to preserve spatial geometry and chemical context. The architecture employs dual E(3)-equivariant graph Transformer encoders to model pocket and ligand embeddings, ensuring representations remain invariant to rotation, translation, and reflection. MolX is pretrained using a hybrid learning paradigm that combines supervised biochemical objectives, logP and energy-gap regression, with self-supervised geometric objectives, coordinate re-construction, and atom-type prediction, fostering generalisable molecular understanding. Across eight downstream benchmarks, including antibody-drug conjugates (ADC), proteolysis-targeting chimeras (PROTAC), molecular glue, and PCBA activity prediction, as well as binding affinity and physicochemical property regression, MolX achieves consistent state-of-the-art performance and strong cross-domain generalisation. Furthermore, MolX incorporates a sparse autoencoder module to decompose latent representations into interpretable biological components, thereby revealing the pocket-ligand interactions that drive prediction outcomes. Together, MolX establishes a scalable and interpretable foundation model for molecular representation learning, providing a unified framework for predicting and interpreting complex small-molecule-protein interactions.
items.summary_zh: MolX 用双路 E(3)-等变 Graph Transformer 联合编码口袋与配体，整合超过 3 million 口袋和 5 million 分子，经 logP、energy-gap 与几何预训练，在 ADC、PROTAC、PCBA 等八项基准上取得当前最优。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为结构药物发现提供可扩展的口袋–配体几何基础模型并带可解释分解；湿实验与代码开源情况摘要未给出。
items.abstract_zh: 理解小分子如何与蛋白质结合口袋相互作用，是基于结构的药物发现的核心。准确建模这些相互作用需要捕获结合界面的 3D 几何与物理化学互补性，然而现有计算方法要么分别编码蛋白质与配体，要么依赖简化的结构表征，并未显式建模跨实体空间关系。这类解耦表征限制了它们捕获由蛋白–配体共组织产生的界面级几何约束的能力。本文提出 MolX，一个从大规模 3D 结构数据中联合学习蛋白质口袋与配体几何及化学表征的 Graph Transformer 基础模型。MolX 整合超过 3 million 个蛋白质口袋和 5 million 个分子，将二者均表示为 E(3)-equivariant 图以保留空间几何与化学语境。该架构采用双路 E(3)-equivariant graph Transformer 编码器来建模口袋与配体嵌入，确保表征对旋转、平移和反射保持不变。MolX 采用混合学习范式预训练，将有监督生物化学目标（logP 与 energy-gap 回归）与自监督几何目标（坐标重建与原子类型预测）相结合，以促进可泛化的分子理解。在八项下游基准上，包括抗体–药物偶联物（ADC）、蛋白水解靶向嵌合体（PROTAC）、molecular glue 与 PCBA 活性预测，以及结合亲和力与物理化学性质回归，MolX 取得一致的当前最优性能和强跨域泛化。此外，MolX 引入 sparse autoencoder 模块，将潜表征分解为可解释的生物学组分，从而揭示驱动预测结果的口袋–配体相互作用。综上，MolX 建立了可扩展且可解释的分子表征学习基础模型，为预测和解释复杂小分子–蛋白质相互作用提供统一框架。
items.author_line: Liu, J., Pan, T., Guo, X. 等 10 人

items.title: CryoLigATE: enhancing the resolvability of cryo-EM maps in protein-ligand complexes using deep learning
items.abstract_or_text: Cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) has become a central tool for structure-based drug discovery, yet ligand-binding sites often remain substantially less well resolved than the surrounding protein, limiting reliable atomic interpretation. Although deep-learning methods have substantially improved overall cryo-EM map quality, their predominantly protein-focused training limits their ability to recover ligand density. Here we present CryoLigATE, a deep learning framework specifically designed to enhance densities associated with protein-bound ligands in cryo-EM maps. We curated a chemically and structurally diverse dataset of more than 6,000 protein-ligand complexes from the EMDB and PDB, encompassing drug-like molecules, lipids, steroids, carbohydrates and other ligand classes, and trained a hybrid convolutional-transformer network to enhance local density around binding pockets. During inference, CryoLigATE automatically extracts the target region from a preliminary atomic model, requiring no manual map preparation and completing localized refinement in seconds on a desktop GPU. Evaluation on an independent test set of 649 complexes demonstrates substantial improvements in ligand resolvability, particularly for maps with poorly resolved binding sites, while preserving high-quality experimental densities. The enhanced maps recover chemically meaningful features, including ligand functional groups and topological continuity, enabling more confident atomic modeling. By learning the structural diversity of ligand features, CryoLigATE addresses a longstanding limitation of cryo-EM map enhancement and provides a useful framework for improving structural interpretation and structure-guided drug discovery.
items.summary_zh: CryoLigATE 在超过 6,000 个 EMDB/PDB 蛋白–配体复合物上训练混合卷积–transformer，自动增强口袋局域密度；在 649 个复合物独立测试集上显著提升配体可分辨性，恢复官能团与拓扑连续性，并保留高质量实验密度。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 针对配体密度长期弱于蛋白的问题给出可落地的局域增强；摘要未报告代码或原子建模成功率的定量指标。
items.abstract_zh: 冷冻电镜（cryo-EM）已成为基于结构的药物发现的核心工具，但配体结合位点的分辨率往往显著低于周围蛋白质，限制了可靠的原子级解释。尽管深度学习方法已大幅提升整体 cryo-EM 图质量，但其训练主要面向蛋白质，限制了恢复配体密度的能力。本文提出 CryoLigATE，一个专为增强 cryo-EM 图中蛋白质结合配体相关密度而设计的深度学习框架。我们从 EMDB 与 PDB 整理了超过 6,000 个化学与结构多样的蛋白–配体复合物数据集，涵盖类药分子、脂质、甾体、碳水化合物及其他配体类别，并训练混合卷积–transformer 网络以增强结合口袋周围的局部密度。推理时，CryoLigATE 从初步原子模型自动提取目标区域，无需手工图准备，并在桌面 GPU 上于数秒内完成局域精修。在 649 个复合物的独立测试集上评估表明，配体可分辨性显著提升，尤其是结合位点解析较差的图，同时保留高质量实验密度。增强后的图恢复了具有化学意义的特征，包括配体官能团与拓扑连续性，从而支持更有把握的原子建模。通过学习配体特征的结构多样性，CryoLigATE 应对了 cryo-EM 图增强的长期局限，为改进结构解释与结构导向药物发现提供了有用框架。
items.author_line: Haloi, N., Howard, R. J., Lindahl, E.

items.title: KITE: Knowledge-Infused Transformer Encoder for Molecular Property Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: The prediction of molecular properties using Artificial Intelligence (AI) is a transformative approach yet the effectiveness of such models depends heavily on the quality of the molecular representation. Deep learning architectures such as Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), combined with Self-Supervised Learning (SSL), have achieved considerable success, but they remain limited in their ability to capture long-range interactions and to integrate fundamental chemical information, such as atomic period, group, and orbital hybridization data. To address these limitations, this study proposes the Knowledge-Infused Transformer Encoder (KITE) model. KITE leverages the strengths of the Transformer architecture, which is well suited to processing long-range dependencies, and integrates fundamental chemical information directly into its input features. The methodology focuses on constructing the KITE model around the Bond-Edge Attention Model (BEAM) architecture to represent information from chemical bonds. The principal design 1 change lies in the atomic features: one-hot encoding is replaced by atom identification based on periodic-table period and group, while the hybridization state is represented by a five-component vector derived from Valence Shell Electron Pair Repulsion (VSEPR) theory. The model was pre-trained using a Knowledge-Guided Pre-training Strategy (KPS) on 965,812 molecules from ChEMBL29 and subsequently fine-tuned on eleven benchmark datasets, nine drawn from MoleculeNet together with the Estrogen and MetStab datasets. Performance was evaluated using the Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve (ROC-AUC) and Root-Mean-Square Error (RMSE) metrics, together with a data contamination analysis based on canonical SMILES. On the eight classification tasks, KITE achieved an average ROC-AUC of 0.854, compared with 0.843 for Knowledge-guided Pre-training of Graph Transformer (KPGT), despite using a pre-training dataset less than half the size. On the three regression tasks, KITE achieved an average RMSE of 1.020, compared with 1.175 for KPGT. The overall exact-molecule contamination rate was 24.9% for KITE and 86.9% for KPGT. These results show that chemically informed atom and bond features can support competitive molecular property prediction with a comparatively small pre-training corpus. Further work should evaluate richer chemical features, alternative fine-tuning strategies, and practical virtual-screening applications with experimental validation.
items.summary_zh: KITE 用周期与族标识及 VSEPR 五维杂化向量替换原子 one-hot，并以 BEAM 编码键信息；在 ChEMBL29 的 965,812 个分子上做 KPS 预训练后，八项分类平均 ROC-AUC 0.854、三项回归平均 RMSE 1.020，精确分子污染率仅 24.9%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把周期表与 VSEPR 先验写进表征，并用污染分析解释相对 KPGT 的增益；湿实验虚拟筛选验证仍缺。
items.abstract_zh: 利用人工智能（AI）预测分子性质是一种具有变革性的方法，但此类模型的有效性在很大程度上取决于分子表征的质量。图神经网络（GNNs）等深度学习架构与自监督学习（SSL）相结合已取得相当成功，但它们在捕获长程相互作用以及整合原子周期、族和轨道杂化等基本化学信息方面仍受限制。为应对这些局限，本研究提出 Knowledge-Infused Transformer Encoder（KITE）模型。KITE 利用 Transformer 架构善于处理长程依赖的优势，并将基本化学信息直接整合到输入特征中。方法上，KITE 围绕 Bond-Edge Attention Model（BEAM）架构构建，以表征化学键信息。主要设计变化在于原子特征：用基于周期表周期和族的原子标识取代 one-hot encoding，而杂化态则由源自 Valence Shell Electron Pair Repulsion（VSEPR）理论的五分量向量表示。该模型使用 Knowledge-Guided Pre-training Strategy（KPS）在来自 ChEMBL29 的 965,812 个分子上预训练，随后在十一个基准数据集上微调，其中九个来自 MoleculeNet，另加 Estrogen 和 MetStab 数据集。性能用受试者工作特征曲线下面积（ROC-AUC）和均方根误差（RMSE）评估，并基于 canonical SMILES 进行数据污染分析。在八项分类任务上，KITE 的平均 ROC-AUC 为 0.854，而 Knowledge-guided Pre-training of Graph Transformer（KPGT）为 0.843，尽管预训练数据集不到后者一半。在三项回归任务上，KITE 的平均 RMSE 为 1.020，KPGT 为 1.175。整体精确分子污染率 KITE 为 24.9%，KPGT 为 86.9%。这些结果表明，化学知情的原子与键特征能够以相对较小的预训练语料支持有竞争力的分子性质预测。后续工作应评估更丰富的化学特征、替代微调策略，以及带实验验证的实际虚拟筛选应用。
items.author_line: Hoang-Huy Nguyen, Van-Thinh To, Tuyen Ngoc Truong 等 4 人

items.title: Integrated BODIPY photosensitizer discovery: Multimodal property prediction, fingerprint diffusion and human-in-the-loop molecular design
items.abstract_or_text: Boron-dipyrromethene (BODIPY) photosensitizers (PS) are important candidates for photodynamic therapy (PDT) and other light-driven applications because of their readily tunable photophysical properties. However, existing molecular design approaches are constrained by insufficient property-prediction accuracy, inefficient structure generation and limited consideration of experimental feasibility. Here, we develop an integrated molecular design framework that combines multimodal property prediction, fingerprint-based molecular diffusion, GRU–SELFIES decoding and human-in-the-loop decision-making. We further develop a Perturbation–Immediate Denoising–Evaluation (PIDE) guidance strategy that decouples molecular generation from property prediction, unlike classifier guidance, which requires a property predictor to estimate properties from noisy intermediate states during diffusion. The framework was trained using 889,033 symmetric BODIPY molecules, whose structural symmetry was introduced to reduce the expected difficulty of chemical synthesis. Compared with PaiNN, Chemprop, random forest, XGBoost and support vector machine baselines, the multimodal fusion model improved R2 by 0.6–86.0% across five regression tasks. The fingerprint diffusion model achieved a molecular validity of 96.88%, compared with 54.79% for GDSS. Complete unconditional generation from random fingerprint initialization through 200 reverse-diffusion steps and GRU–SELFIES decoding to SMILES required 0.000911 ± 0.000009 s per molecule. When benchmarked using the same device, GDSS required 4.3704 s per generated sample (approximately 4,797-fold higher). The GRUSELFIES model correctly translated 93.5% of fingerprint-derived tokens and exactly reproduced the reference SMILES for 82.1% of molecules, with 100% molecular validity and an approximately 193-fold speedup over the Transformer–SMILES decoder. Following automated QSPR-based ranking, human experts participate in every round of guided molecular optimization rather than evaluating the candidates only after the entire generation process is completed. At each round, experts assess the synthetic accessibility, commercial availability of starting materials and empirical chemical value of the proposed molecules. This iterative interaction enables overestimated out-of-distribution candidates to be identified and removed at an early stage, preventing them from being propagated into subsequent rounds of guidance and reducing the risk of investing wet-laboratory resources in poorly supported candidates.
items.summary_zh: 面向 BODIPY 光敏剂，结合多模态性质预测、指纹扩散、GRU–SELFIES 解码与人在环决策，并提出 PIDE 引导；在 889,033 个对称分子上训练，五任务 R2 相对基线提升 0.6–86.0%，指纹扩散有效性 96.88%，生成较 GDSS 快约 4,797 倍。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把生成与性质预测解耦并引入化学家轮次筛选，降低 OOD 高估风险；目前主要是计算指标，湿实验落地仍待开展。
items.abstract_zh: Boron-dipyrromethene（BODIPY）光敏剂（PS）因其易于调控的光物理性质，是光动力治疗（PDT）及其他光驱动应用的重要候选。然而，现有分子设计方法受限于性质预测精度不足、结构生成效率低以及对实验可行性考虑有限。本文开发一个集成分子设计框架，结合多模态性质预测、基于指纹的分子扩散、GRU–SELFIES 解码以及人在环决策。我们进一步提出 Perturbation–Immediate Denoising–Evaluation（PIDE）引导策略，将分子生成与性质预测解耦，这不同于 classifier guidance——后者要求性质预测器在扩散过程中从带噪声的中间状态估计性质。该框架用 889,033 个对称 BODIPY 分子训练，引入结构对称性以降低预期化学合成难度。相对 PaiNN、Chemprop、random forest、XGBoost 和支持向量机基线，多模态融合模型在五项回归任务上使 R2 提升 0.6–86.0%。指纹扩散模型的分子有效性为 96.88%，而 GDSS 为 54.79%。从随机指纹初始化出发，经 200 步反向扩散和 GRU–SELFIES 解码到 SMILES 的完整无条件生成，每个分子耗时 0.000911 ± 0.000009 s。在同一设备上基准评测时，GDSS 每个生成样本需要 4.3704 s（约高 4,797 倍）。GRUSELFIES 模型正确翻译了 93.5% 的指纹衍生 token，并精确复现了 82.1% 分子的参考 SMILES，分子有效性为 100%，相对 Transformer–SMILES 解码器约快 193 倍。在基于 QSPR 的自动排序之后，人类专家参与每一轮引导分子优化，而不是仅在整个生成过程结束后评估候选。在每一轮中，专家评估所提分子的合成可及性、起始原料的商业可得性以及经验化学价值。这种迭代交互使被高估的分布外候选能够在早期被识别并剔除，防止其传入后续引导轮次，并降低把湿实验室资源投入证据不足候选的风险。
items.author_line: Junpeng Chen, Yanrong Song, Yikun Li 等 13 人

items.title: onepot-Bench 0: towards lab-aware in silico chemistry benchmarks
items.abstract_or_text: Language models are playing an increasingly important role in laboratory science, performing tasks such as experiment planning, execution, and post-hoc analysis. However, precisely measuring their abilities is difficult, as scientific capabilities require a mixture of both problem-solving skills and domain-specific intuition. Existing evaluations rarely measure the capabilities required to make reliable decisions in a physical laboratory and often rely on public data that may have appeared in model training corpora. We introduce onepot-Bench 0, a proprietary benchmark suite for evaluating language models on synthetic chemistry capabilities relevant to wet-lab execution. onepot-Bench 0 comprises three complementary evaluations: ChemAbacus measures tool-free cheminformatics literacy and numerical reasoning; SynthRefusal characterizes safety and refusal behavior across a variety of benign, controlled, and designer-drug targets; and SynthBench evaluates reaction-outcome prediction and catalyst selection using private experimental data generated in our laboratory. Together, these evaluations probe basic competency, reliability, and deeper knowledge, all skills which are required for reliable performance in the lab.
items.summary_zh: 提出面向湿实验的专有化学基准 onepot-Bench 0，含 ChemAbacus、SynthRefusal 与基于实验室私有数据的 SynthBench，分别评估化学信息学素养、安全拒答以及反应结果预测与催化剂选择。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 用私有实验数据降低训练污染，更贴近真实合成决策；目前只评语言模型，覆盖反应类型仍有限，分任务分数摘要未列出。
items.abstract_zh: 语言模型在实验室科学中扮演着越来越重要的角色，执行实验规划、实施与事后分析等任务。然而，精确衡量其能力十分困难，因为科学能力需要问题解决技能与领域直觉的结合。现有评估很少衡量在实体实验室中作出可靠决策所需的能力，并且常常依赖可能已出现在模型训练语料中的公开数据。我们推出 onepot-Bench 0，一套专有基准套件，用于评估语言模型在与湿实验执行相关的合成化学能力。onepot-Bench 0 包含三项互补评估：ChemAbacus 衡量无需工具的化学信息学素养与数值推理；SynthRefusal 刻画跨良性、受控和 designer-drug 目标的安全与拒答行为；SynthBench 使用我们实验室产生的私有实验数据评估反应结果预测与催化剂选择。这些评估共同探测基本胜任力、可靠性与更深知识，这些都是实验室可靠表现所需的技能。
items.author_line: Brandon Wang, Andrei S. Tyrin, Daniil A. Boiko

items.title: Fate of hydrogen sulphide on refractory oxide nanoparticles via foundation model-accelerated atomistic modelling and in situ spectroscopy
items.abstract_or_text: Understanding the intricate interactions between hydrogen sulphide (H2S) and complex metal oxides is of paramount interest for both advancing industrial catalysis, such as H2S conversion to H2, and fundamental perspectives, such as unravelling the role of refractory interstellar dust within the sulphur depletion problem or in prebiotic catalysis. In both settings the chemistry is governed by the high-surface-area, structurally heterogeneous terminations that dominate at the nanoscale, including facets of differing stability, steps, and point defects; however, the vast configurational space of these chemically diverse and reactive interfaces makes exhaustive first-principles sampling prohibitively expensive. In this work, we address this by integrating unbiased, automated high-throughput adsorption sampling with readily available atomistic foundation models in a hierarchical screen-and-refine workflow. We systematically investigate H2S adsorption across three prototypical refractory oxide materials: amorphous silica, forsterite (Mg2SiO4), and pristine and defective MgO. A state-of-the-art foundation model was used to explore, without chemical bias, the configurational space of H2S–surface interactions, revealing a broad range of surface phenomena, transitioning from non-covalent, hydrogen-bonded physisorption on hydroxylated silica, to dissociative adsorption on Mg2SiO4 facets and highly reactive Schottky divacancy pairs in MgO. The resulting atomistic datasets are assessed against experimental in situ infrared (IR) spectroscopy. Our simulated multiconfigurational compound IR spectra reproduce the position, ordering and qualitative shape of the experimental features, including the complex low-frequency tails and the progressive red-shifting of characteristic H–S and O–H stretching modes across the three materials. This combined theoretical and experimental framework establishes a transferable methodology for the study of refractory nanostructured surfaces in Earth and astrochemical settings and provides a pipeline for the rational design of next-generation catalysts for sustainable processes and green chemistry applications.
items.summary_zh: 将原子级基础模型接入无偏高通量吸附采样，系统研究 H2S 在无定形二氧化硅、镁橄榄石（Mg2SiO4）与本征/缺陷 MgO 上的吸附，模拟多构型 IR 光谱并与原位实验对照，再现峰位、排序与 H–S/O–H 红移。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把基础模型采样与原位光谱衔接，降低难熔氧化物界面穷尽 DFT 的成本；光谱对照仍偏定性，催化转化性能未直接验证。
items.abstract_zh: 理解硫化氢（H2S）与复杂金属氧化物之间的精细相互作用，对推进工业催化（例如 H2S 转化为 H2）以及基础问题（例如厘清难熔星际尘埃在硫亏损问题或前生命催化中的作用）都至关重要。在这两种情形下，化学过程由纳米尺度占主导的高比表面积、结构异质终止面控制，包括稳定性不同的晶面、台阶和点缺陷；然而这些化学多样且活泼界面的巨大构型空间，使穷尽的第一性原理采样代价过高。本文通过将无偏、自动化的高通量吸附采样与现成的原子级基础模型整合到分层筛选–精修工作流中来应对这一问题。我们系统考察 H2S 在三种典型难熔氧化物材料上的吸附：无定形二氧化硅、镁橄榄石（Mg2SiO4），以及本征与缺陷 MgO。用一种先进基础模型在无化学偏置的条件下探索 H2S–表面相互作用的构型空间，揭示了广泛的表面现象，从羟基化二氧化硅上的非共价氢键物理吸附，过渡到 Mg2SiO4 晶面上的解离吸附，以及 MgO 中高活性 Schottky 双空位对。所得原子级数据集与实验原位红外（IR）光谱对照。我们模拟的多构型复合 IR 光谱再现了实验特征的位置、排序和定性形状，包括复杂的低频尾以及三种材料中特征 H–S 与 O–H 伸缩模式的逐步红移。这一理论与实验结合的框架，为难熔纳米结构表面在地球与星体化学情境中的研究建立了可迁移方法，并为下一代可持续过程与绿色化学催化剂的理性设计提供了管线。
items.author_line: Eric Mates-Torres, Lorenzo Mino, Guillermo Escolano-Casado 等 6 人

items.title: Bi-semantic Chemical Embedder for Joint Representation Learning of SMILES and Natural Language
items.abstract_or_text: Transformer models have revolutionized natural language processing (NLP), and text-based molecular representations like SMILES have successfully extended these architectures to chemistry. However, domain-adaptive pre-training often causes models to overfit to chemical syntax, catastrophically forgetting their foundational semantic capabilities. To address this challenge, we introduce CheMatE, a chemistry-oriented embedding model that jointly captures molecular structure and domain-specific natural language within the same representation space. Built on a ModernBERT backbone, CheMatE learns bi-semantic representations through a two-stage training procedure: continued masked language modeling (MLM) followed by a Matryoshka contrastive learning stage via Multiple Negative Ranking Loss (MNRL). First, we train the model using MLM on a novel, large-scale corpus of SMILES-annotated, long-context scientific documents that were constructed and curated from FineWeb and ChemPile (comprising 10.4B and 11.5B tokens, respectively). Subsequently, the model undergoes contrastive learning using a synthetic dataset of SMILES-text pairs algorithmically derived from our original training corpus. This design exposes the model to SMILES-enriched scientific literature, enabling bi-semantic understanding. We evaluate CheMatE across a range of downstream tasks covering molecular property prediction and scientific language understanding. Our results demonstrate that coupling our custom-curated datasets with this sequential training strategy yields robust, highly transferable representations. By effectively unifying structural and contextual signals within a single text-based framework, CheMatE achieves competitive performance across both specialized chemistry models and general-purpose language model baselines.
items.summary_zh: 提出 CheMatE：以 ModernBERT 为骨干，先在 FineWeb 与 ChemPile 的 SMILES 标注长上下文语料（10.4B 与 11.5B token）上继续 MLM，再用 MNRL 做 Matryoshka 对比学习，在同一空间联合编码分子结构与科学自然语言。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 针对领域自适应预训练遗忘语义的问题，提供可检索的化学–文本双语义嵌入；摘要未给出分任务数值与代码。
items.abstract_zh: Transformer 模型彻底改变了自然语言处理（NLP），而 SMILES 等基于文本的分子表征已成功将这些架构扩展到化学领域。然而，领域自适应预训练常常使模型过拟合于化学语法，灾难性遗忘其基础语义能力。为应对这一挑战，我们推出 CheMatE，一个面向化学的嵌入模型，在同一表征空间中联合捕获分子结构与领域特异自然语言。CheMatE 以 ModernBERT 为骨干，通过两阶段训练学习双语义表征：持续的掩码语言建模（MLM），随后是经由 Multiple Negative Ranking Loss（MNRL）的 Matryoshka 对比学习阶段。首先，我们在一个新颖的大规模语料上用 MLM 训练模型，该语料由经过 SMILES 标注的长上下文科学文献构成，并自 FineWeb 与 ChemPile 构建和整理（分别包含 10.4B 和 11.5B 个 token）。随后，模型使用由原始训练语料算法派生的 SMILES–文本对合成数据集进行对比学习。这一设计使模型接触富含 SMILES 的科学文献，从而实现双语义理解。我们在覆盖分子性质预测与科学语言理解的一系列下游任务上评估 CheMatE。结果表明，将我们定制整理的数据集与该序贯训练策略相结合，能够得到稳健、高度可迁移的表征。通过在单一基于文本的框架中有效统一结构信号与上下文信号，CheMatE 在专用化学模型和通用语言模型基线之间均取得有竞争力的性能。
items.author_line: David Ming Segura, Jeremy Goumaz, Joshua W. Sin 等 5 人

items.title: CheMLFlow: An Open-Source Platform for Cheminformatics and Materials Informatics Applications
items.abstract_or_text: CheMLFlow is an open-source platform for building and executing end-to-end, high-throughput, and agentic workflows for scientific and technological applications. CheMLFlow targets a common bottleneck in scientific machine learning development, where researchers often need to assemble data acquisition, curation, representation, model training, validation, screening, interpretation, and reporting into a reproducible pipeline, even when their primary research contribution concerns only one stage. CheMLFlow provides modular workflow components, ready-to-run reference pipelines, standardized artifacts, and evaluation outputs that reduce orchestration overhead and support benchmarking across methods and datasets. The platform is designed to be extensible, reproducible, and automation friendly, with pluggable representations and models, deterministic splits, explicit run artifacts, batch execution, and report generation. As scientific software increasingly moves toward agent assisted experimentation, CheMLFlow's configuration driven workflows and structured outputs also provide a practical interface for coding agents to help users construct experiments, inspect results, and summarize findings under human supervision. This article describes the system architecture, core workflows, and benchmarks that reach literature performance for quantum mechanical, physicochemical and bioactivity property prediction, and use cases involving time series datasets demonstrating applications beyond molecular chemistry datasets.
items.summary_zh: CheMLFlow 开源平台用模块化、可复现的配置驱动工作流串联化学信息学与材料信息学的采集、表征、训练、验证与报告，并在量子力学、物理化学与生物活性性质预测上达到文献性能，也可用于时间序列数据。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 降低 AI×Chem 管线编排成本并预留编码智能体接口；摘要未给出分任务数值与外部用户复现证据。
items.abstract_zh: CheMLFlow 是一个开源平台，用于构建和执行面向科学与技术应用的端到端、高通量及智能体工作流。CheMLFlow 针对科学机器学习开发中的常见瓶颈：研究者往往需要把数据采集、整理、表征、模型训练、验证、筛选、解释与报告组装成可复现管线，即便其主要研究贡献只涉及其中一个阶段。CheMLFlow 提供模块化工作流组件、即用参考管线、标准化产物与评估输出，以降低编排开销并支持跨方法与数据集的基准评测。该平台被设计为可扩展、可复现且便于自动化，具有可插拔表征与模型、确定性划分、显式运行产物、批量执行与报告生成。随着科学软件日益走向智能体辅助实验，CheMLFlow 的配置驱动工作流与结构化输出也为编码智能体提供实用接口，帮助用户在人类监督下构建实验、检查结果并总结发现。本文描述系统架构、核心工作流，以及在量子力学、物理化学与生物活性性质预测上达到文献水平的基准，并给出时间序列数据集用例，表明其应用可超出分子化学数据。
items.author_line: Brendan Smith, Susana Lopez-Moreno, Eric Dolores-Cuenca 等 6 人

items.title: Automated Framework for Molecular Multipole Calculations: Benchmarking DFT Methods and Dataset Generation for
items.abstract_or_text: Molecular electric dipole and quadrupole moments are fundamental descriptors of charge distribution and intermolecular electrostatics, with applications spanning spectroscopy, forcefield parameterization, and the design of proton-conducting materials. Despite their importance, the calculation of multipole moments from density functional theory (DFT) typically requires specialized post-processing of the electron density, and validated benchmark datasets remain scarce for chemistries of interest. Here, we present an open-source Python framework that automates the calculation of molecular dipole and quadrupole moments from plane-wave and Gaussian-type-orbital DFT, supporting both total-electron-density and charge-density-difference formulations. The framework is validated against experimental references for a 99-molecule dipole benchmark and a 54-molecule quadrupole benchmark across five density functional approximations, with ωB97M-V yielding the lowest mean absolute deviation for dipoles (0.07 D) and the closest agreement with experimental quadrupoles (mean absolute percent deviation 11.3%). The strong inter-method agreement among the modern functionals tested (mean absolute percent deviation below 5% relative to r2SCAN) indicates that the residual disagreement with experimental quadrupole moments is dominated by uncertainty in the experimental reference data rather than by limitations of the underlying electronic structure methods. We further demonstrate the utility of the framework by generating a dataset of 242 substituted azoles relevant to non-aqueous proton conduction, and show that the computed dipole and quadrupole moments report on complementary aspects of the molecular charge distribution: dipoles track tautomeric form and substituent electronic character, while quadrupoles track molecular size and spatial extent. A Random Forest model trained on identity-based structural descriptors recovers the computed dipoles to within 0.5 D for weakly perturbing substituents but fails for strong electron-withdrawing groups. Plotting the per-substituent prediction errors against the Hammett σp constant reveals a clear monotonic trend, indicating that electronically resolved descriptors such as Hammett constants will be valuable inputs for future machine learning models of multipole moments. The framework, benchmark results, and azole dataset are released openly to support high-throughput electronic structure data generation, force-field parameterization, and machine learning studies of multipole-aware materials design.
items.summary_zh: 开源框架自动计算平面波与高斯轨道 DFT 的分子偶极/四极矩；ωB97M-V 偶极 MAD 为 0.07 D，并生成 242 个取代唑数据集。Random Forest 对弱取代基误差小于 0.5 D，但对强吸电子基失效，误差随 Hammett σp 单调上升。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 补上稀缺的多极矩基准与唑类数据，并点明纯结构描述符的失效边界；机器学习部分仍较初步，尚未做外部化学空间测试。
items.abstract_zh: 分子电偶极矩与四极矩是电荷分布与分子间静电作用的基本描述符，应用覆盖光谱学、力场参数化以及质子传导材料设计。尽管重要，从密度泛函理论（DFT）计算多极矩通常需要对电子密度做专门后处理，而面向感兴趣化学体系的经过验证的基准数据集仍然稀缺。本文给出一个开源 Python 框架，可从平面波与高斯型轨道 DFT 自动计算分子偶极矩与四极矩，同时支持总电子密度与电荷密度差两种表述。该框架在 99 分子偶极基准和 54 分子四极基准上对照实验参考，并比较五种密度泛函近似，其中 ωB97M-V 给出最低的偶极平均绝对偏差（0.07 D），并与实验四极矩最接近（平均绝对百分偏差 11.3%）。受测现代泛函之间一致性很强（相对 r2SCAN 的平均绝对百分偏差低于 5%），表明与实验四极矩的残余分歧主要由实验参考数据的不确定性主导，而非底层电子结构方法的局限。我们进一步用该框架生成与非水质子传导相关的 242 个取代唑类数据集，并表明计算得到的偶极矩与四极矩报告分子电荷分布的互补方面：偶极矩跟踪互变异构形式与取代基电子特征，四极矩跟踪分子尺寸与空间延展。在基于身份的结构描述符上训练的 Random Forest 模型，对弱扰动取代基可将计算偶极矩恢复到 0.5 D 以内，但对强吸电子基团失效。将逐取代基预测误差对 Hammett σp 常数作图呈现出清晰的单调趋势，表明 Hammett 常数等电子分辨描述符将是未来多极矩机器学习模型的有价值输入。框架、基准结果与唑类数据集开源发布，以支持高通量电子结构数据生成、力场参数化以及面向多极感知材料设计的机器学习研究。
items.author_line: Yifan Liu, Brock A. Dyer, Valentino R. Cooper

items.title: Physics-Based Molecular Fingerprints from Spectral Graph Theory Provide Efficient Geometry-Aware Measures of Chemical Similarity
items.abstract_or_text: Molecular representations are essential for the evaluation of molecular similarity and the development of structure-property relationships. Despite the known importance of 3D structure to determine chemical and physical properties, the most widely used molecular fingerprints encode only two-dimensional connectivity. Such representations fail to distinguish similar but distinct stereoisomers and conformers. Alternative 3D methods are typically defined pairwise, making their application to large chemical spaces prohibitive, while deep learning embeddings are expressive but uninterpretable and limited by their training data diversity. Here, we introduce novel physics-inspired molecular fingerprints based on principles from spectral graph theory. We represent molecules as a complete graph in 3D space, with edge weights encoding heuristic physical interactions. Eigenvalue decomposition of the resulting graph Laplacian matrix results in a computationally efficient fixed-length chemical fingerprint that encodes 3D structure while obeying necessary physical symmetries of permutation and E(3) invariance. Spectral fingerprints differentiate between unique molecular structures with identical 2D connectivity, overcoming a limitation of 2D descriptors, while maintaining the low computational cost needed for efficient screening of vast chemical spaces. We evaluate our fingerprints with community detection algorithms and observe strong performance against representative baselines across datasets from organic, inorganic, biological, reticular, and reaction chemistry. Nearest-neighbor property estimation and applicability domain analyses reveal the utility of our molecular representation in machine learning and cheminformatics. We anticipate that spectral fingerprints will serve as generalizable, interpretable, and efficient measures of chemical similarity that incorporate 3D information at minimal cost.
items.summary_zh: 提出基于谱图论的物理启发分子指纹：将分子表示为边权编码物理相互作用的 3D 完全图，对拉普拉斯矩阵特征分解得到置换与 E(3) 不变定长指纹，可区分同 2D 连接性的立体/构象异构体，并在有机、无机、生物、网状与反应化学数据上表现良好。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 以低成本把 3D 几何写入可解释指纹，便于大规模相似性检索；摘要未给出回归基准数值与湿实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 分子表征对于评估分子相似性并建立结构–性质关系至关重要。尽管已知 3D 结构对决定化学与物理性质很重要，最广泛使用的分子指纹仍只编码二维连接性。这类表征无法区分相似但不同的立体异构体与构象异构体。替代的 3D 方法通常按成对定义，使其难以应用于大规模化学空间，而深度学习嵌入虽表达力强但不可解释，并受训练数据多样性限制。本文引入基于谱图论原理的新型物理启发分子指纹。我们将分子表示为 3D 空间中的完全图，边权编码启发式物理相互作用。对所得图拉普拉斯矩阵做特征值分解，得到计算高效、定长的化学指纹，在编码 3D 结构的同时服从必要的置换与 E(3) 不变物理对称性。谱指纹能够区分具有相同 2D 连接性的独特分子结构，克服了 2D 描述符的局限，同时保持高效筛选广阔化学空间所需的低计算成本。我们用社区发现算法评估这些指纹，并在有机、无机、生物、网状与反应化学数据集上相对代表性基线观察到强性能。最近邻性质估计与适用域分析揭示了该分子表征在机器学习与化学信息学中的效用。我们预期谱指纹将作为可泛化、可解释且高效的化学相似性度量，以极小代价纳入 3D 信息。
items.author_line: Jacob W. Toney, Ayleen Y. Farnood, Samir Darouich 等 4 人

items.title: DASyR-LLM: Domain-Aware Symbolic Regression with LLMs for Kinetic Model Discovery
items.abstract_or_text: Kinetic model discovery is a central challenge in chemical engineering, as accurate rate expressions are essential for understanding and controlling chemical and biological processes. Symbolic regression (SR) has emerged as a powerful data-driven approach for identifying interpretable kinetic models, but usually operates without domain knowledge, often exploring physicochemically implausible models. Large language models (LLMs) offer a promising avenue for injecting domain expertise into this search. Here, we introduce an LLM-guided SR framework, embedding an LLM module within an iterative SR algorithm for automated kinetic model discovery. The LLM performs two roles at each iteration: (1) a qualitative physicochemical critique of the best SR candidates, and (2) the proposal of new candidate rate expressions guided by the SR-generated models and embedded chemical knowledge. Our framework is evaluated on four in silico case studies of increasing complexity, spanning heterogeneous catalysis and bioprocess systems. Results show the LLM-guided framework reduces iterations to identify the ground-truth model by 41.7-79.3\% versus a state-of-the-art SR framework, with the LLM directly proposing the correct model structure in over half of the guided runs. In practical settings, where each iteration typically requires a new wet-lab experiment, this translates into a substantial reduction in experimental effort. Predictive performance on an independent validation set is equivalent between both approaches, with R^2>0.98 in all case studies. Ablation studies indicate that both the SR component and the LLM scale contribute to this performance, with a reduced-size LLM largely retaining discovery efficiency. These findings demonstrate that LLMs can effectively inject domain knowledge into scientific model discovery, paving the way toward fully automated, domain-aware kinetic modelling pipelines.
items.summary_zh: DASyR-LLM 把 LLM 嵌入迭代符号回归，对速率表达式做物理化学评判并提议新模型；在四个催化与 bioprocess 的 in silico 案例中将找到 ground-truth 的迭代减少 41.7–79.3%，独立验证集 R^2>0.98。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把化学先验写入动力学发现，有望减少湿实验轮次；目前主要为 in silico 数据，真实实验闭环尚未展示。
items.abstract_zh: 动力学模型发现是化学工程的核心挑战，因为准确的速率表达式对理解与控制化学和生物过程至关重要。符号回归（SR）已成为识别可解释动力学模型的有力数据驱动方法，但通常在没有领域知识的情况下运行，往往探索物理化学上不合理的模型。大语言模型（LLMs）为将领域专长注入这一搜索提供了有前景的途径。本文引入一个 LLM 引导的 SR 框架，将 LLM 模块嵌入迭代 SR 算法，用于自动化动力学模型发现。LLM 在每次迭代中承担两个角色：（1）对最佳 SR 候选做定性物理化学评判，（2）在 SR 生成模型与嵌入化学知识引导下提出新的候选速率表达式。我们在四个复杂度递增的 in silico 案例研究上评估该框架，覆盖多相催化与 bioprocess 系统。结果表明，相对当前最优 SR 框架，LLM 引导框架将识别 ground-truth 模型所需迭代次数减少 41.7–79.3%，并且在超过一半的引导运行中由 LLM 直接提出正确模型结构。在每次迭代通常需要一次新湿实验的实际设定中，这转化为实验工作量的显著下降。两种方法在独立验证集上的预测性能相当，所有案例研究中 R^2>0.98。消融研究表明 SR 组件与 LLM 规模都对性能有贡献，缩小规模的 LLM 大体保留发现效率。这些发现表明 LLM 能有效将领域知识注入科学模型发现，为完全自动化、领域感知的动力学建模管线铺平道路。
items.author_line: Roberto Aliaga Medina, Paulina Quintanilla, Antonio del Rio Chanona

items.title: Data-Driven Discovery of Structure–Reactivity Relationships in Oxidative Addition at Zerovalent Nickel Centers
items.abstract_or_text: Understanding the factors that control CO 2 insertion into Ni–alkyne complexes is essential for improving the regioselectivity of Ni-catalyzed reductive carboxylation reactions. Here, we combine highperformance computing, experimental validation, and interpretable machine learning to identify structurereactivity relationships governing oxidative cyclization of CO 2 at zerovalent bipyridine–Ni–alkyne complexes. The MACE machine-learning interatomic potential (MLIP) was used to generate a large thermochemical dataset of optimized Ni–alkyne reactants and Type-I/Type-II nickelacycle products, enabling systematic analysis of reaction Gibbs free energies and regioisomer stability across a broad ligandsubstrate space. Experimental IR spectra of representative Ni–alkyne complexes confirmed key structural assignments but also revealed that MACE-optimized geometries underestimate Ni-to-alkyne πbackbonding, leading to systematically blue-shifted alkyne stretching frequencies relative to experiment and DFT. Despite this limitation, MACE-derived relative free energies provided useful thermodynamic descriptors for product regioselectivity when CO 2 insertion was experimentally observed. Equivariant graph neural networks predicted reaction free energies directly from reactant geometries with high accuracy, while GNNExplainer localized the dominant structural information to the Ni–alkyne fragment and nearby alkyne substituents. Complementary random-forest models showed that overall CO 2 -insertion thermodynamics are governed primarily by alkyne sterics, Ni-center accessibility, and product nickelacycle stabilization, whereas regioselectivity is controlled primarily by the electronic asymmetry of the alkyne substituents, with secondary contributions from steric congestion and product metallacycle stability. These results establish a scalable, experimentally anchored workflow for using MLIP-generated datasets and interpretable machine learning to discover chemically meaningful design rules in organometallic CO 2 -functionalization chemistry.
items.summary_zh: 用 MACE MLIP 生成零价 bipyridine–Ni–alkyne 上 CO2 氧化环化的热化学数据，结合实验 IR 与等变 GNN/random-forest，揭示插入热力学由立体与可及性支配、区域选择性由取代基电子不对称控制，并报告 MACE 低估 π-backbonding。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把 MLIP 高通量与可解释 ML、实验光谱锚在一起，给出 CO2 羧化设计规则；MACE 几何系统偏差需用 DFT 校正。
items.abstract_zh: 理解控制 CO2 插入 Ni–alkyne 配合物的因素，对提高镍催化还原羧化反应的区域选择性至关重要。本文将高性能计算、实验验证与可解释机器学习相结合，识别支配零价 bipyridine–Ni–alkyne 配合物上 CO2 氧化环化的结构–反应性关系。使用 MACE 机器学习原子间势（MLIP）生成大规模热化学数据集，包含优化的 Ni–alkyne 反应物以及 Type-I/Type-II nickelacycle 产物，从而在广阔的配体–底物空间中系统分析反应 Gibbs 自由能与区域异构体稳定性。代表性 Ni–alkyne 配合物的实验 IR 光谱确认了关键结构指认，但也揭示 MACE 优化几何低估了 Ni 向 alkyne 的 π-backbonding，导致 alkyne 伸缩频率相对实验与 DFT 系统性蓝移。尽管有此局限，当实验观测到 CO2 插入时，MACE 导出的相对自由能仍为产物区域选择性提供了有用的热力学描述符。等变图神经网络可直接从反应物几何高精度预测反应自由能，而 GNNExplainer 将主导结构信息定位到 Ni–alkyne 片段及邻近 alkyne 取代基。互补的 random-forest 模型表明，整体 CO2 插入热力学主要由 alkyne 立体效应、Ni 中心可及性与产物 nickelacycle 稳定化支配，而区域选择性主要由 alkyne 取代基的电子不对称性控制，立体拥挤与产物 metallacycle 稳定性为次要贡献。这些结果建立了一个可扩展、有实验锚定的工作流，用于利用 MLIP 生成数据集与可解释机器学习，在有机金属 CO2 官能化化学中发现有化学意义的设计规则。
items.author_line: Sarah N. Elliott, Rosmi Reji, Qingzhi Chen 等 10 人

items.title: Chelatron: Charting Chemical Space with Agentic AI for Metal-Ligand Discovery
items.abstract_or_text: Automating scientific discovery has been a long-standing objective in the scientific community, and the recent advances in artificial intelligence, particularly large language models and agentic workflows, have made this goal increasingly feasible. In chemistry, however, many problems remain limited by sparse data and fragmentary prior knowledge, leading standard data-driven approaches to struggle. In these low-data settings, progress should instead be accelerated by autonomous systems that strategically generate new informative data. Here, we introduce Chelatron, an agentic platform for autonomous metal-ligand design that leverages large language model-based reasoning to coordinate an iterative, hypothesis-driven framework of molecular discovery via effective chemical space exploration. The platform emulates key elements of the scientific method by proposing chemically meaningful hypotheses, generating candidate molecules, evaluating molecular properties, and using accumulated evidence to guide subsequent exploration. As an initial demonstration, we apply Chelatron to the design of chelators for actinium, an element whose scarcity and radioactivity have left its coordination chemistry underexplored. Across two campaigns, Chelatron proposed 119 hypotheses for improving chelator design and screened nearly 65,000 candidate molecules. 3D metal-chelator structures were constructed and evaluated at the xTB-level of theory for around 2,500 chelators, of which 679 were predicted to bind actinium comparable to or more favorable than the reference chelator, macropa, and are under further investigation. These results demonstrate Chelatron as an operational framework to accelerate hypothesis-driven discovery in data-limited metal-ligand chemistry.
items.summary_zh: Chelatron 用大语言模型智能体循环提出假设、生成并评估金属–配体分子；在锕螯合剂设计中提出 119 条假设、筛选近 65,000 个候选，约 2,500 个经 xTB 评估，679 个优于或接近 macropa。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在数据稀缺的锕配位化学中展示可运行的假设驱动探索；目前主要为 xTB 计算筛选，实验验证仍在进行。
items.abstract_zh: 自动化科学发现长期是科学界的目标，而人工智能尤其是大语言模型和智能体工作流的近期进展使这一目标日益可行。然而在化学中，许多问题仍受稀疏数据和零碎先验知识限制，使标准数据驱动方法陷入困境。在这些低数据设定下，进展应由能够策略性生成新信息数据的自主系统来加速。本文推出 Chelatron，一个面向自主金属–配体设计的智能体平台，利用基于大语言模型的推理来协调迭代的、假设驱动的分子发现框架，以有效探索化学空间。该平台通过提出化学上有意义的假设、生成候选分子、评估分子性质，并用累积证据指导后续探索，来模拟科学方法的关键要素。作为初步示范，我们将 Chelatron 应用于锕的螯合剂设计；该元素因稀缺和放射性，其配位化学仍探索不足。在两次活动中，Chelatron 提出了 119 条改进螯合剂设计的假设，并筛选了近 65,000 个候选分子。对约 2,500 个螯合剂构建了 3D 金属–螯合剂结构并在 xTB 理论水平评估，其中 679 个被预测对锕的结合与参考螯合剂 macropa 相当或更有利，目前正在进一步考察。这些结果表明 Chelatron 是一个可运行的框架，可加速数据有限的金属–配体化学中的假设驱动发现。
items.author_line: Thomas J. Summers, Logan Ward, Logan J. Augustine 等 12 人

items.title: PG-MLD: Physics-Guided Molecular Representation Learning via Dynamic 3D Trajectory Distillation
items.abstract_or_text: Molecular representation learning underpins molecular property prediction and drug design by capturing molecular structure-property relationships. SMILES-based molecular language models learn chemical semantics from large-scale unlabeled data and support efficient inference. However, the one-dimensional nature of SMILES constrains their ability to capture 3D geometry and conformational evolution, whereas 3D molecular models require conformer generation and substantial computational resources. To bridge this gap, we propose PG-MLD, a dynamic 3D-to-1D physical knowledge distillation paradigm for molecular representation learning. PG-MLD constructs a dynamic 3D physical teacher by combining equivariant geometric encoding with Liquid Time-Constant modeling to capture 3D geometry, atom-level electronic descriptors, and conformational evolution. PG-MLD subsequently distills the learned trajectory knowledge into SMILES-based students through atom- and molecule-level representation alignment and cross-modal contrastive learning, with masked language modeling retained where supported. The distilled students perform downstream tasks using only SMILES, without conformer generation or molecular dynamics simulations. Experiments on MoleculeNet show that PG-MLD improves overall property prediction performance across three molecular language student architectures while maintaining SMILES-only inference. The learned representations also encode 3D geometry and conformational dynamics more effectively, demonstrating that dynamic 3D physical knowledge can be transferred to SMILES-based molecular language models with different architectures.
items.summary_zh: PG-MLD 以等变几何编码与 Liquid Time-Constant 构建动态 3D 教师，经原子/分子对齐与跨模态对比把轨迹知识蒸馏到 SMILES 学生模型；在 MoleculeNet 上提升三类分子语言学生的性质预测，推理只需 SMILES。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 让 SMILES 模型廉价获得 3D/动力学信息，适合大规模筛选；摘要未给出分任务数值与外部分布测试。
items.abstract_zh: 分子表征学习通过捕获分子结构–性质关系，支撑分子性质预测和药物设计。基于 SMILES 的分子语言模型从大规模未标注数据中学习化学语义并支持高效推理。然而，SMILES 的一维本质限制了它们捕获 3D 几何与构象演化的能力，而 3D 分子模型则需要构象生成并消耗大量计算资源。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 PG-MLD，一种面向分子表征学习的动态 3D 到 1D 物理知识蒸馏范式。PG-MLD 通过将等变几何编码与 Liquid Time-Constant 建模相结合构建动态 3D 物理教师，以捕获 3D 几何、原子级电子描述符和构象演化。随后，PG-MLD 通过原子级与分子级表征对齐以及跨模态对比学习，把学得的轨迹知识蒸馏到基于 SMILES 的学生中，并在支持的情况下保留掩码语言建模。蒸馏后的学生仅使用 SMILES 执行下游任务，无需构象生成或分子动力学模拟。在 MoleculeNet 上的实验表明，PG-MLD 在三种分子语言学生架构上整体提升了性质预测性能，同时保持仅 SMILES 推理。学得的表征也更有效地编码 3D 几何与构象动力学，表明动态 3D 物理知识可以迁移到不同架构的基于 SMILES 的分子语言模型。
items.author_line: liu, Z., Wu, Z., Chen, Z. 等 5 人

items.title: Boltz-Perturb: Improving Diversity and Accuracy in Protein-Ligand Co-Folding through Training-Free Conditioning Perturbation
items.abstract_or_text: Protein-ligand co-folding models hold promise in structure-based drug discovery and small molecule interaction prediction, but often fail in predicting correct small molecule binding poses. We present Boltz-Perturb, a framework for addressing this through perturbing model conditioning signals during model inference, and show that such perturbations improve correct ligand binding mode predictions. We first show with true-coordinate injection experiments that the models learned energy landscape contains correct binding-mode basins, allowing us to reframe the problem as one of sampling deficiency. We then introduce two inference-time perturbation strategies, Token Bias Perturbation (TBP) and Token Conditioning Perturbation (TCP), which increase exploration of alternative binding poses. Across diverse protein-ligand systems, TCP improves top-20 oracle success rates by 2.6 to 7.8 fold. Boltz-Perturb attains higher oracle success rates compared to the Boltz-2 high diffusion temperature variant while requiring over 75% less compute. To our knowledge, this is the first systematic perturbation analysis of a co-folding architecture for small-molecule binding mode diversity. We demonstrate that inference-time perturbations can unlock latent structural diversity in generative co-folding models and improve protein-ligand predictions without costly retraining.
items.summary_zh: Boltz-Perturb 在推理时用 TBP 与 TCP 扰动共折叠条件信号；真实坐标注入显示正确结合盆地已存在，TCP 将 top-20 oracle 成功率提高 2.6–7.8 倍，相对 Boltz-2 高温扩散计算量减少超过 75%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 无需重训练即可提升配体姿态多样性与准确性；目前主要是 oracle 成功率，真实对接或实验验证仍缺。
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白–配体共折叠模型在基于结构的药物发现与小分子相互作用预测中具有前景，但往往无法预测正确的小分子结合姿态。我们提出 Boltz-Perturb，通过在模型推理过程中扰动条件信号来应对这一问题，并表明此类扰动可改善正确配体结合模式的预测。我们首先用真实坐标注入实验表明，模型学得的能量景观包含正确的结合模式盆地，从而将问题重新表述为采样不足。随后引入两种推理时扰动策略：Token Bias Perturbation（TBP）与 Token Conditioning Perturbation（TCP），以增加对替代结合姿态的探索。在多样的蛋白–配体体系中，TCP 将 top-20 oracle 成功率提高 2.6 至 7.8 倍。Boltz-Perturb 相对 Boltz-2 高扩散温度变体取得更高的 oracle 成功率，同时计算量减少超过 75%。据我们所知，这是对共折叠架构中小分子结合模式多样性的首次系统扰动分析。我们表明，推理时扰动可以解锁生成式共折叠模型中的潜在结构多样性，并在无需昂贵重训练的情况下改善蛋白–配体预测。
items.author_line: Jung, H., Lee, B., Cheng, A. C.

items.title: Machine learning for sample-based quantum diagonalization: generative configuration recovery and the classical-simulability frontier
items.abstract_or_text: Sample-based quantum diagonalization (SQD), equivalently quantum-selected configuration interaction (QSCI), has in two years become a pragmatic centre of gravity of pre-fault-tolerant quantum chemistry: a quantum processor samples electronic configurations, and the many-electron Hamiltonian is diagonalized classically in the resulting determinant subspace. Its accuracy is set entirely by which configurations enter that subspace, a selection problem for machine learning made acute by a coupon-collector bottleneck. We critically review the ecosystem of generative and learned selectors, organizing it by the object each method generates and the importance signal it exploits, and expose one conspicuous gap: a reward-proportional generative-flow-network proposer built for tail discovery. We then confront the field's central question -- whether the quantum sampler beats classical selected configuration interaction -- and report a carefully scoped negative: across published same-active-space comparisons, strong classical selected CI matches or beats the quantum-sampled subspace, and the flagship single-layer circuits now admit polynomial-time classical energy estimation. We distil a benchmarking standard and turn the negative into a regime map, then test it with FCI-exact experiments that confirm one prediction and refute another: the cheap prior's rank correlation with the exact weights declines with multireference character (a usable coordinate), but a controlled single-molecule noise sweep shows the one generative advantage we find, robustness to valid-shot starvation, to be generic rather than the multireference-specific effect a confounded contrast first suggested. Finally, we flag learning from quantum experiments, whose classical sample-complexity lower bound is an unconditional theorem, as the one adjacent frontier where a quantum advantage is provable but not yet bridged to chemistry.
items.summary_zh: 系统评述 SQD/QSCI 中的生成式与学习式组态选择器，指出缺少面向尾部发现的 GFlowNet 提议器；在同活性空间比较中强经典 selected CI 不逊于量子采样，并用 FCI 精确实验确认/推翻区间图预测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 给容错前量子化学的 ML 选择器划出可用区间并报告否定结果；尚未把可证量子优势接到具体化学任务。
items.abstract_zh: 基于采样的量子对角化（SQD），亦即量子选择组态相互作用（QSCI），在两年内已成为容错前量子化学的务实重心：量子处理器采样电子组态，再在所得行列式子空间中经典对角化多电子哈密顿量。其精度完全取决于哪些组态进入该子空间，这对机器学习构成选择问题，并因优惠券收集瓶颈而尤为尖锐。我们批判性回顾生成式与学习式选择器的生态，按各方法生成的对象及其利用的重要性信号加以组织，并指出一个显著空白：面向尾部分布发现、按奖励比例的 generative-flow-network 提议器。随后我们直面该领域的核心问题——量子采样器是否优于经典选择组态相互作用——并报告一个范围审慎的否定结论：在已发表的相同活性空间比较中，强经典 selected CI 匹配或优于量子采样子空间，且旗舰单层线路现在允许多项式时间的经典能量估计。我们提炼一套基准评测标准，将这一否定转化为区间图，再用 FCI 精确实验加以检验：一项预测得到确认，另一项被推翻——廉价先验与精确权重的秩相关随多参考特征下降（一个可用坐标），但受控的单分子噪声扫描表明，我们所发现的唯一生成优势（对有效 shot 匮乏的稳健性）是通用的，而非先前混杂对照所暗示的多参考特异效应。最后，我们指出从量子实验中学习这一相邻前沿——其经典样本复杂度下界是无条件定理——是可证明量子优势存在、但尚未桥接到化学的方向。

review.note: 2026-08-05 候选 60 篇，自动分仍偏高并夹杂胎儿超声、病理合成、电力系统、足球预测与通用智能体稿。按 AI×Chem 相关性、方法可信度与验证强度精选 16 篇：当日新增 MolX、CryoLigATE、CheMLFlow、谱图论 3D 指纹、SQD 组态选择评述、DASyR-LLM、镍 CO2 氧化加成与 Boltz-Perturb，并保留 KITE、BODIPY、CheMatE、onepot-Bench、H2S 吸附与原位红外、多极矩 DFT、Chelatron 与 PG-MLD；未收录组织病理扩散、涂层聚合、聚合物交联纯 DFT、无 AI 的紫杉醇递送与通用工具智能体等弱相关项。
